core_identity.short_form: Green seeks acceptance through nature, instinct, growth, and belonging.
core_identity.summary: Green is the mono-color expression of the living web: it trusts that the world already has shape, that beings have innate roles, and that strength comes from growing into what is natural.
core_identity.philosophy: Green asks what is already true beneath ambition, artifice, and fear. It does not reject change, but it prefers change that unfolds from nature's own pattern.
core_identity.central_tension: Green can offer deep belonging and primal power, but it can over-trust the existing system or become helpless when its chosen creatures and natural tools fail.

structure.non_faction_boundary: Green is an official color philosophy and mechanical color-pie identity, not a single plane, faction, personality type, or commander recommendation list.

great_tension.gift: Green remembers that life already belongs to something larger than itself.
great_tension.shadow: Green can call a system natural when it is only familiar.
great_tension.boundary: This is Vox Mana synthesis from official color philosophy, not official psychometrics.

mechanics.summary: Green commonly plays through creatures, mana, lands, growth, combat through bodies, and natural answers to artificial or airborne threats.

site_surface.short_summary: Green trusts nature, instinct, growth, and the web of life to reveal what each being already is.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Green is the root that knows the forest before the map is drawn.

data_quality.notes: Three native mono-green commander rows are retained only after current Scryfall verification on 2026-06-13. Deck links remain intentionally empty; these rows do not prove color philosophy or Vox Mana placement axes.

research_limitations: Do not treat Green as anti-change in an absolute sense; sources frame Green as accepting slow, purposeful natural evolution.
Do not treat Vox Mana placement axes as official Wizards scores.
Do not promote candidate commanders without current card/legal verification.
Do not use generated runtime files as claim evidence.

profile.overview: Green is the color of acceptance, nature, growth, instinct, interdependence, tradition, and belonging.
profile.philosophy: Green believes the world is already a living system and that peace comes from discovering and fulfilling one's place in it.
profile.core_tension: Green's certainty in the natural order can become over-reliance on familiar systems or resistance to needed change.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Green commonly expresses itself through creatures, lands, mana, counters, Fight/Bite, reach, trample, and natural answers to artifacts, enchantments, and fliers.
